novelty.justification: The claim's novelty route is a pre-edit mechanistic relationship: "logically-entailed fact pairs occupy shared, aligned representational subspaces" and disconnected "consistency seams" predict and causally block ripple propagation. Searches around “pre-edit representation geometry predict knowledge-edit ripple,” “subspace alignment logical consistency knowledge editing,” and “gradient similarity ripple effects” identify GradSim in Why Does New Knowledge Create Messy Ripple Effects in LLMs (2024) as the closest predictor, while STEAM (2025) already links isolated residual-stream representations and latent-space alignment to post-edit reasoning coherence; neither, however, proposes an edit-free pairwise geometry predictor of ripple failure from native representations. The step is therefore a substantive but natural extension combining established linear-representation/CCA tools with existing gradient-coupling and latent-alignment accounts, distinguished by changing the unit of analysis to pre-existing entailed-fact coupling rather than introducing an entirely new measurement paradigm.
